import openpyxl, json
p='inputs/delivery.xlsx'
import os
for root,d,f in os.walk('inputs'):
    print(root,f)
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=True)
wf=openpyxl.load_workbook(p, data_only=False)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws=wb[name]; wsf=wf[name]
    print('SHEET',name, ws.max_row, ws.max_column)
    for r in range(1, min(ws.max_row,4)+1):
        row=[]
        for c in range(1, ws.max_column+1):
            v=ws.cell(r,c).value; fv=wsf.cell(r,c).value
            row.append((ws.cell(r,c).coordinate, repr(v), type(v).__name__, repr(fv) if isinstance(fv,str) and fv.startswith('=') else ''))
        print(row)
    print('---')
ws=wb['Export']; wsf=wf['Export']
print('Export col C all rows:')
for r in range(1, ws.max_row+1):
    print(r, repr(ws.cell(r,1).value), repr(ws.cell(r,3).value), repr(wsf.cell(r,3).value))
ws1=wb['Counts']; ws2=wb['Pack factors']
print('Counts', [(ws1.cell(r,1).value, ws1.cell(r,2).value) for r in range(1,ws1.max_row+1)])
print('Packs', [(ws2.cell(r,1).value, ws2.cell(r,2).value) for r in range(1,ws2.max_row+1)])
